name: linuxpath
description: Reproducible validation harness for the LinuxPath static learning application.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run install:browsers --silent && LINUXPATH_E2E_TARGET=source playwright test --project=source
scripts.test:e2e:dist: npm run install:browsers --silent && LINUXPATH_E2E_TARGET=dist playwright test --project=dist
scripts.test:e2e:offline: npm run install:browsers --silent && LINUXPATH_E2E_TARGET=offline playwright test --project=offline
